definition_en: The IRI that identifies the municipality in the ontology namespace; the join key between the database row and the ontology.
business_rule_en: Every row has exactly one IRI.

definition_en: The six-digit code of a municipality in ČSÚ codelist 43 (the same code is used in RÚIAN).
business_rule_en: Every municipality has exactly one integer code from ČSÚ codelist 43.

definition_en: The official Czech name of a municipality as listed in ČSÚ codelist 43.
business_rule_en: Every municipality has exactly one Czech name; names are not unique.

definition_en: An English note on a municipality; present only where it needs one (the military training areas).
business_rule_en: A municipality has at most one English definition.

definition_en: The IRI that identifies the anonymisation area in the ontology namespace; the join key between the database row and the ontology.
business_rule_en: Every row has exactly one IRI.

definition_en: The publisher's integer identifier of an anonymisation area in its list of areas.
business_rule_en: Every anonymisation area has exactly one integer identifier assigned by the publisher.

definition_en: A coordinate property that gives the WGS-84 latitude of the centre of an anonymisation area, the point published as the location of every offence record in the area.
scope_note_en: Not the geometric centroid of the polygon: the publisher's defining point (field def_bod_y), a K-means cluster centre, moved inside the municipality where needed.
business_rule_en: Every anonymisation area has exactly one centre latitude between -90 and 90 degrees.

definition_en: A coordinate property that gives the WGS-84 longitude of the centre of an anonymisation area, the point published as the location of every offence record in the area.
scope_note_en: Not the geometric centroid of the polygon; see krim:centreLatitude. The publisher's field def_bod_x.
business_rule_en: Every anonymisation area has exactly one centre longitude between -180 and 180 degrees.

definition_en: A relation that places an anonymisation area in the municipality whose territory contains it.
scope_note_en: Given by the publisher's list of areas (field kod_obec); every area lies in exactly one municipality.
value_domain: code from codelist municipality (6258 values, see appendix)
business_rule_en: Every anonymisation area lies in exactly one municipality.

business_rule_en: Every codelist concept has exactly one Czech label and at most one label per other language.

definition_en: The IRI that identifies the offence record in the ontology namespace; the join key between the database row and the ontology.
business_rule_en: Every row has exactly one IRI.

definition_en: The publisher's integer identifier of an offence record, stable across the publisher's download files and refreshes.
business_rule_en: Every offence record has exactly one integer identifier assigned by the publisher.

definition_en: A date-time property that gives the date and time, to the minute and with time zone, at which the recorded act was entered into the Police CR register as reported.
scope_note_en: Not the time of commission. The publisher's help (napoveda, "Filtrování dle období") states that an act reported on one day but entered into the register the next day appears under the next day. Times of exactly 00:00 may stand for an unknown time of day.
value_domain: xsd:dateTime; ISO 8601 text, local time with offset where published
business_rule_en: Every offence record has exactly one report date and time.

definition_en: A relation that places an offence record in the anonymisation area whose centre is published as the record's location.
scope_note_en: Derived by the loader: the published point is the centre of exactly one area. A point that is no area's centre is a data error and is reported, never placed in the nearest area.
value_domain: identifier of a row in anonymisation_area
business_rule_en: Every offence record lies in exactly one anonymisation area, the one whose centre is its published point.

definition_en: A boolean property that states whether an offence record originates from a municipal police force rather than the Police of the Czech Republic.
scope_note_en: Realises the source field "mp" (městská policie). The publisher's OpenAPI description (/api/v2/docs.json) splits statistics into "sp" (state police) and "mp" (municipal police) and describes the codelist flag "mp" as "offence class shared with the municipal police". The help pages state that municipal-police offences are being integrated through a dedicated interface.
business_rule_en: Every offence record states whether it was recorded by the municipal police.

definition_en: A relation that assigns its current clearance state to an offence record.
value_domain: code from codelist clearance_state (4 values, see appendix)
business_rule_en: Every offence record has exactly one clearance state.

definition_en: A relation that states what the recorded location of an offence record stands for.
value_domain: code from codelist location_relevance (6 values, see appendix)
business_rule_en: Every offence record has exactly one location relevance.

definition_en: A date-time property that gives the moment as of which the publisher reported the current state of an offence record (its clearance state, types and location).
scope_note_en: Observation time, not event time: it says when the state was known, not when the act was reported (krim:reportDateTime). Records are investigated continuously and republished, so a state can change; only the latest observed state is kept, and a clearance rate is meaningful only together with this date. Taken from the publisher's 'updated' timestamp of the download that last contained the record.
value_domain: xsd:dateTime; ISO 8601 text, local time with offset where published
business_rule_en: Every offence record states exactly one moment as of which its current state was reported.

definition_en: Identifier of the offence record that the link row belongs to.
value_domain: identifier of a row in offence_record
business_rule_en: Every link row belongs to exactly one owner.

definition_en: A relation that assigns an offence type to an offence record.
scope_note_en: A record usually has several types: the most specific ones and all their broader types.
value_domain: code from codelist offence_type (132 values, see appendix)
business_rule_en: Every offence record has at least one offence type.
